chunk_map.heading: The best mitigation is the door you don't open
It runs without you until Day 2

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 "The best mitigation..." line 3: "Before the agent reads anything" - 'the agent' is not named in this file, but the lecture sits after apt101-only-what-you-tell-it and apt101-build-your-product-memory in our-product-our-system.md include order (module-arc carve-out); chunk 2 line 5 names 'The digest agent' itself. Closest: 'Its lines turn up in summaries' - 'Its' binds 'a source' in the preceding sentence.

chunk 2 line 5: 'Day 2 opens on what it wrote.' names the next day by title, not by position of another file; no 'the opening lecture' style pointers (grep 'lecture|earlier|previous' on slide bodies -> 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2: 'only what the team agreed may go in' resolves to the exercise What goes in (our-product-our-system.md line 56), which exists in the module's current include set. No 'the X you did' phrasing elsewhere.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no live demo or guess beat

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 line 5 is short (173 words incl. block) but carries one self-standing claim: the digest runs unattended on agreed sources and is ready by morning; not a wait-state.

chunk 1 header 'The best mitigation is the door you don't open' vs body: 'decide what it never gets to read... A source you never let in needs no such hunt' - summary holds. Closest: chunk 2 header 'It runs without you until Day 2' vs 'leaves the digest ready by morning' - consistent.

chunk 1: 'The interview notes... The ticket export... The folder nobody remembers sharing.' is anaphora on 'The' but each leg carries new concrete content (names, phone numbers, unknown sharing), so the triple-rule exception holds. grep for 'Not .*\. Not' -> 0; superlatives ('most|best' in body) -> only header 'best mitigation', a claim about the practice not a self-grade of the training; number+retraction 0; no empty verb triplets.
